title: An empty imp array still lets crosscheck run, unlike an absent imp key
specNotes: `imp: []` fails the same root check as an absent imp key (`!Array.isArray(req.imp) || !req.imp.length`, 2.6 §3.2.1), so request-side validation is identical to field-shape-imp-missing. But crosscheck's own gate is only `!Array.isArray(req.imp)` (buildRequestView) — an empty array IS an array, so the view builds successfully with an empty impression index, and the response bid falls through to the ordinary unresolved-impid path instead of the whole-payload no_request short-circuit. Distinct from both field-shape-imp-missing (imp key absent entirely, buildRequestView returns null, no per-bid findings at all) and field-shape-imp-id-missing (one imp present but unindexed because its own id is absent).
